basecolor_gpu_raw.method: Deferred SceneCapture SCS_BASE_COLOR -> RGBA16F -> raw linear pixel readback; equal-area UV0 plane
basecolor_gpu_raw.limitations: 256px UV-plane samples imported GPU texture/mips, not every source mip0 texel; GBuffer/compression quantization included.

basecolor_gpu_analysis.interpretation: Five iron variants have zero measured BaseColor variance. Direct GPU capture of the UNCHANGED ORIGINAL iron material also has zero variance at BOTH 256 and 1024, so this is pre-existing imported/rendered behavior rather than newly lost detail. Exact codec/mip cause is not claimed. Original PNG and UV/Normal/ORM graph preservation are separately proven. Ideal box-filter predictions are supplementary and do not reproduce the GPU codec.
basecolor_gpu_analysis.scope: 24 color targets pass fixed tolerance; stone grain visible; iron detail matches original rendered baseline. Raw zero-variance flags remain preserved; no claim that original iron has visible BaseColor grain.
